title: Hydrogeologic framework of west-central South Carolina
citation: Aadland, R.K., Gellici, J.A., and Thayer, P.A., 1995, Hydrogeologic framework of west-central South Carolina: South Carolina Department of Natural Resources Water Resources Report 5 [200 p.], map scale 1:250,000.
publisher: South Carolina Department of Natural Resources
notes: SCDNR Water Resources Report 5 (Aadland, Gellici and Thayer, 1995), plates only: well location maps (plates 1-2) and regional hydrostratigraphic sections across the Savannah River Site (plates 3-10, vertical scale 0-200 ft, horizontal 0-6 miles). Unit names as printed on sections; ages, descriptions and hydrostratigraphic system boundaries are not legible in the text layer. Section A-A' and E-E' holes and land-surface elevations read from the plate images; D-D' and G-G' from the text layer, elevations paired with hole labels by order (consistent where wells repeat: P-17 332 ft, PBF-1 276 ft, P-22 215 ft). Plate 4 (B-B'), C-C', F-F' and H-H' holes, hole spacings, geophysical-log intervals and contacts not digitized. P-27 and P-28 elevations differ by 1-2 ft between sections as printed. The Millers Pond well at the west end of D-D' (Burke County, Ga.) is left out; other holes are in South Carolina. SUBSURFACE: unit contacts on all sections not digitized; fault traces named only.
